article.title: Japanese car rental markets in everything
article.excerpt: People are renting cars, but then not driving them at all: One respondent to the company’s survey said they rented vehicles to nap in or use for a workspace. Another person stored bags and other personal belongings in the rental car when nearby coin lockers were full.
